column1: # The citizen's build menu, read off a vanilla Art of Conquest game, one row per
# epoch. `-` is an empty position. Bottom row first, then `/`, then the top row.
# Format and reasoning as in barracks_slots.tsv.
# Buildings share positions the same way units do, which is the part that
# matters: the Archery Range retires and the Airport takes its slot, the Stable
# retires and the Tank Factory takes its slot. Hold either open and its
# successor never appears — no Airport, no Tank Factory, and none of the units
